title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Monday, 26 October 2026
description: Nvidia's Jensen Huang floats a $2,000-per-GPU annual software fee for AI agents, Foodbank Australia reports 3.6 million households facing food insecurity, a draft water plan alarms far-west Queensland graziers, and the Gold Coast welcomes its first flight from Western Sydney Airport. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
